entities.summary: Gladson de Lima Cameli is a Brazilian politician and engineer. He had represented Acre in the Federal Senate from 2015 to 2019. Cameli is the incumbent Governor of Acre since 2019. Previously, he was a deputy from Acre from 2007 to 2015. He is a member of Progressistas (PP). He has been implicated in the Petrobras scandal.
